worldcombat.skill.confuseray.summary: Fires a beam of eerie light in a chosen direction or at a world point; on a hit it is left confused, so each action it attempts may be wasted and its own force turns on it when it lands a hit. The light travels in a straight line, so the first wall or body truncates it, and firing into open air is fine.
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.0: Single-target disruption from range, making a heavy hitter swing wide
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.1: Interrupt ranged pressure from a safe distance
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.use.2: Open a miss window before an ally's focus fire
worldcombat.skill.confuseray.description: A hit leaves the target confused for %1$s: each action it attempts has about a one-in-three chance to be wasted, and when it lands a hit its own force turns back on it, dealing self-damage scaled by its own Attack - but the backlash never exceeds the damage that hit actually dealt.

Fire in a direction or at a point; no target is required. Base range: %1$s blocks, hit radius: %2$s blocks; the current range is %3$s blocks. The beam travels in a straight line, needs a clear line of sight, and the first body or block truncates it; only the first non-ally on the line is affected.

Preparation %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s. Wide reaches farther. Focus extends confusion duration by ×1.35, at the cost of shorter range, 0.2 seconds more preparation and about 15% longer cooldown. Both use the same hit radius and failure chance.
Wide: range ×1.25. Focus: confusion duration ×1.35, but range ×0.75, preparation +0.2 seconds and cooldown ×1.15. Hit radius and failure chance are unchanged.
The partner only considers firing while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee range, larger lets it chase out for a first strike.
On a wind-up: fire only while the target attacks the partner or its owner, or right after the partner is hit, to break up the attack. Anytime: fire on any threat as pure disruption.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to fire.
